arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kroger argued the Court should dismiss the case due to lack of standing.
Ms. Kubitschek argued no case or controversy exists between the parties.
Justice Ginsburg questioned why the official would face liability without a challenge.
Justice Kennedy asked about the official's current occupation and record details.
